profile.summary: Handy Snacks Ltd is a Cypriot maker of potato chips and extruded snacks that the Frou Frou Group agreed to buy in 2010. It sells potato chips and potato sticks under the Handy Snacks brand, which the company says are made from locally grown Cypriot potatoes.
profile.founded: 1964 (Frou Frou parent group); Handy Snacks joined the group in 2010
profile.ownership: Part of the Frou Frou Group, alongside Alkis H. Hadjikyriacos (Frou Frou Biscuits) Public Ltd and Spinneys Cyprus Ltd
products: Cyprus Potato Chips (90 g and 8 x 45 g packs; flavours include Sea Salt, No Added Salt, Prawn Cocktail, Vinegar & Oregano, Vinegar & Sea Salt, Souvla)
Corn snacks, cheese curls and popcorn (not stated to be potato-based)

plants.capacity_as_stated: Group factory; the website does not say where the potato chips are made or give a capacity

markets: Group exports to Europe, the Middle East, the Far East, Africa and America; the website does not say which export products are potato chips
certifications: Group quality management system based on ISO 22000:2018 (scope for snack production not stated)

contact.address: 115, Grigori Afxentiou Avenue, Kokkinotrimithia Industrial Area, 2660 Nicosia, Cyprus

facts: Registration number HE268693
Mon Ami (acquired 2013) and Bakandys Industry (acquired 2015) also operate under Handy Snacks Ltd
Group factory moved from Engomi to Kokkinotrimithia in 2007

profile.summary: Aviko is a Dutch maker of fries and other potato products, part of the Dutch cooperative Cosun. It was started in 1962 in Hoog-Keppel by 32 potato farmers to make chilled fries and is now based in Steenderen. The company says it has eleven production sites in five countries and about 2,500 employees.
profile.ownership: Part of the Dutch cooperative Cosun
products: Fries, including thin fries for air fryers
Potato specialties such as Pom' Duchesse and rösti rounds

plants.country: Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Poland and China

markets: Consumers, foodservice and industry customers; the website says its products reach tables around the world
facts: Original name: Aardappel Verwerkende Industrie Keppel en Omstreken
Moved to a larger factory in Steenderen about ten years after founding
About 2,500 employees
limitations: Capacity, plant towns, export countries and certifications are not published on the pages read.

profile.summary: Emsland Group is a German producer of starch products from potatoes and peas, headquartered in Emlichheim. It says it processes more than 2.2 million tonnes of potatoes a year across its group and makes native and modified starches, potato flakes and granules, proteins and fibres.
products: Protein and fibre products for food
Starch products for adhesives, construction additives, textiles and filter materials

plants.capacity_as_stated: Group processes more than 2.2 million tonnes of potatoes

markets: Export share of more than 75 percent
facts: About 1,500 employees
Seven production sites in Germany
More than 160,000 tonnes of peas processed
Emsland-Stärke GmbH is main shareholder of Mecklenburg Kartoffelveredlung GmbH, Hagenow
limitations: Ownership structure and turnover unit are not stated on the pages read.

profile.summary: McCain Foods is a Canadian maker of frozen fries, potato products and appetizers, founded in 1957 by the McCain brothers in Florenceville, New Brunswick. The company says it has 49 production facilities, more than 20,000 employees and sells in 160 countries. Its corporate head office is in Toronto.
profile.ownership: Described by the company as a family company

plants.town: 49 production facilities (towns not listed); first plant in Florenceville, New Brunswick

contact.address: 439 King Street West, 5th Floor, Toronto, ON, Canada M5V 1K4

facts: Founders: Wallace, Harrison, Robert and Andrew McCain
Global revenues stated as over C$16 billion
Business units include McCain Foods, Lutosa, Van Geloven, Forno de Minas, Strong Roots and Day & Ross (transport)

profile.summary: HZPC is a Dutch potato breeding and seed potato company with its head office in Joure. It was formed in 1999 by the merger of Hettema (founded 1898) and ZPC (founded 1919). The company states seed potato sales of 941,000 tonnes, exports to 96 countries and more than 130 protected varieties.
profile.founded: 1898 (Hettema & Sons, Bitgum); merged with ZPC into HZPC in 1999
products: Minitubers (9 million a year in the Netherlands)
facts: About 400 employees
Turnover about EUR 415 million
About 1,000 growers
HZPC Research: 80+ staff, 8 teams, about EUR 11 million R&D a year

profile.summary: EUROPLANT is a German potato breeding and seed potato company based in Lüneburg. It was founded in 1992 as the sales company for the Böhm breeding house and its cooperative partners, whose breeding roots go back to 1900. The company offers more than 100 varieties for table, processing and starch use and says it operates in over 70 countries.
profile.ownership: Founded as the sales company of Kartoffelzucht Böhm GmbH & Co. KG and the cooperatives Vereinigte Saatzuchten Ebstorf-Rosche eG, Raiffeisen Centralheide eG and Stader Saatzucht eG
products: In vitro plants, minitubers and pre-basic seed
markets: Subsidiaries in the Netherlands, United Kingdom, USA, France, Poland, Denmark, Spain and Romania
facts: More than 100 varieties, about one third suited to organic growing
Took over the operational seed potato business of its shareholders in 2002
limitations: Volumes, employees and breeding-station locations are not published on the pages read.

profile.summary: Agrico is a Dutch potato cooperative of more than 1,200 growers that breeds varieties and trades seed and other potatoes. It was formed in 1973 and has its head office in Emmeloord. The company reports turnover of EUR 537 million for 2024/2025 and a network of subsidiaries and distributors in more than 80 countries.
profile.ownership: Cooperative owned by more than 1,200 growers
products: Protected varieties, including Next Generation varieties with natural late blight resistance
markets: More than 80 countries through subsidiaries and distributors
facts: Turnover EUR 537 million in 2024/2025
Group companies named alongside Agrico: Semagri and BioSelect
limitations: Volumes, number of varieties and employees are not published on the pages read.

profile.summary: Kiremko is a Dutch maker of potato processing lines based in Montfoort, now a product brand of Foodera Technologies. Foodera groups Kiremko, Idaho Steel and Reyco Systems and supplies lines for French fries, flakes, formed mash, hash browns, potato chips and pellet snacks.
profile.ownership: Part of Foodera Technologies, with Idaho Steel and Reyco Systems
machines: French fry lines, including coated fries

profile.summary: TOMRA Food makes sensor-based sorting machines, steam peelers and post-harvest systems, with its main office in Leuven, Belgium. It is a division of TOMRA Systems ASA of Asker, Norway, founded in 1972. For potatoes it offers sorters for field and fresh-pack potatoes, fries and chips, and steam peeling lines.
profile.ownership: Business division of TOMRA Systems ASA, Asker, Norway
machines: TOMRA 3A (foreign-material removal, field and fresh-pack potatoes)
TOMRA 5B (belt sorter for fries and potato chips)
Orbit, Odyssey and Eco steam peelers
markets: TOMRA group: present in over 100 countries

contact.address: Research Park Haasrode 1622, Romeinse straat 20, 3001 Leuven, Belgium

facts: TOMRA group: over 5,800 employees; revenue about EUR 1.32 billion (2025)
Group divisions: TOMRA Collection, TOMRA Recycling, TOMRA Food

profile.summary: GRIMME is a family-run German maker of machinery for planting, harvesting, storing and handling potatoes, beet and vegetables, founded in 1861 in Damme, Lower Saxony. The group states 3,300 employees, 38 locations and sales of EUR 792 million in 2025, and is active in over 120 countries.
profile.ownership: Family business; the fourth and fifth generations of the Grimme family manage GRIMME Holding
